_doc: P294 executed-PoC verifier — RESEARCH-ONLY, ADVISORY, UN-WIRED. The FP oracle: a candidate is 'confirmed' ONLY when a declared EXPLOIT test in its pocs/<id>/ dir actually runs under forge and PASSes AND satisfies L1+L2+L3. attacker_verified is derived from the real run + structural parse, never from a self-asserted status or an assertion-string scan. Never submits, never sets severity, never reaches confirm_gate/min_confirm_gate.
_recall_open_doc: Default OFF. When ON (a LATER phase), static lenses/gates emit advisory candidates that all route to this verifier; the verifier is the sole confirmer. OFF preserves all existing behavior byte-for-byte; this phase demonstrates the flow by invoking the verifier over a candidate list directly (no edit to existing modules).
